_doc: Every Ledger entry (design/slice/content.md §6). kind: clue, person, insight, model, trial or question. A question opens as soon as any id in 'opens' is known and lists its 'clues'. A question with 'options' is a deduction: once all its 'needs' are known you pick an answer, and the right one ('answer', an index) teaches 'insight'. A question with 'closes' is answered when that id is known.

veiled_figure.title: The veiled figure in the fire
veiled_figure.text: It rose from the flames on the College stairs, pulled me out with a spell, then walked backwards into the fire and lay down.

walker_star.title: A brass star at its wrist
walker_star.text: The veiled figure wore a small brass star at its wrist.

star_nick.title: The nick in its star
star_nick.text: The figure's brass star has a nick on one point.

own_star.title: My brass star
own_star.text: I've had it since I was small. One point is nicked.

pillow_note.title: A note under my pillow
pillow_note.text: Folded small, in the College's old star cipher.

pillow_note_read.title: "Don't say how it ends."
pillow_note_read.text: The note under my pillow, read at last.

noon_note.title: "Day four. Noon. Sit with them."
noon_note.text: A cipher note on the archive desk. Wren read it for me.

cipher.title: The star cipher
cipher.text: Wren taught me the College's old cipher. I can read the notes myself now.

wren.title: Wren
wren.text: Keeps the archive. Warm, funny, curious. Forgets me every loop.

wren_sea.title: Wren's secret
wren_sea.text: After the Eclipse, Wren wants to see the sea. Wren has never told anyone else. Telling Wren this makes Wren trust me.

orrery_wrong.title: The Orrery runs slow
orrery_wrong.text: Since the night of the light the Orrery loses a hair every hour, as if winding back. The Provost was inside it that night.

shard.title: The hanging shard
shard.text: A sliver of amber light hangs in the archive and won't move.

loop_known.title: The month starts again
loop_known.text: I died, and woke on day 1 on the burning stairs. I remember everything. Nobody else does.

silas.title: Silas Vane
silas.text: A rival student, a duelist who never misses. Practice duels on day 6.

silas_again.title: "Again?"
silas_again.text: Silas said 'Again?' when he saw me, then tried to cover it.

silas_remembers.title: Silas remembers
silas_remembers.text: He knew I'd got better 'since last time'. Silas remembers the loops too.

silas_tell.title: Silas's opening
silas_tell.text: In a duel he always opens with a long lance of lightning from across the yard. Step aside, then punish.

trial_yard.title: The yard trial
trial_yard.text: Passed once. The examiner only asks for one wave now.

burnt_door.title: The Observatory door
burnt_door.text: Burnt through from the inside, though the bolt is drawn on the outside.

scorch_match.title: A star-shaped scorch
scorch_match.text: My own Ember Bolt leaves the same five-pointed scorch as the Observatory door.

warning_chalk.title: Chalk on the north door
warning_chalk.text: Cipher, chalked neatly at head height.

warning_read.title: "Not before the bell."
warning_read.text: The chalk on the north door, read.

tide.title: The voice at the north door
tide.text: At dusk on day 7 Pell hears Wren outside the north door and opens it. It isn't Wren.

died_north_door.title: The north door killed me
died_north_door.text: At dusk on day 7 the dark came through the north door. I could bar it before then.

died_patrol.title: The Hollows in the street killed me
died_patrol.text: The night patrol is no place for an Apprentice. The yard trial and a few days of practice first, or slip away home.

died_mill.title: The risen at the Mill killed me
died_mill.text: They can't be killed, only knocked down, and they keep getting up. Someone at the Mill might know what keeps them back.

died_alone.title: I faced the Eclipse alone
died_alone.text: Surviving day 7 isn't enough. Someone has to sit up with me on the last night.

the_bell.title: The bell
the_bell.text: At the last hour of day 7 the College bell rings, and whatever is at the north door goes away.

gate_letter.title: A letter in the College gate
gate_letter.text: Wedged in tight, in the star cipher.

combination.title: Seven numbers
combination.text: "For the Gate, when it turns." What gate?

mourner.title: The mourner
mourner.text: On day 3 at noon, a veiled stranger in the market saw me and wept, then backed away.

saying_shadow.title: "Never greet your own shadow."
saying_shadow.text: What the old woman in the market said when I chased the mourner. They backed away faster than I could run.

dog_corner.title: The empty corner
dog_corner.text: On days 2 and 3 a dog won't go near one empty corner of the square.

footprints.title: Footprints ahead of nobody
footprints.text: Day 6, the plateau road: footprints appear in the frost ahead of nobody, leading back to the city.

second_lantern.title: The second lantern
second_lantern.text: A second lantern at Mira's door, with her mark. Its flame burns inward. It isn't hers.

mill_day5.title: The Mill, day 5
mill_day5.text: The dead at the Mill get up on the afternoon of day 5.

millrace.title: The millrace
millrace.text: Aldous says the risen won't cross the millrace.

risen.title: The risen
risen.text: Dead Hollows at the Mill rise and walk backwards, toward me.

closing_wound.title: The closing wound
closing_wound.text: A risen Hollow's claw cut Aldous, and the cut closed as the claw passed back through it.

notes_are_ours.title: The notes are ours
notes_are_ours.text: Every cipher note is something I tell Wren on the Long Night, written in Wren's hand.

trap_told.title: "Then I won't go."
trap_told.text: I told Wren how the road ends. Wren wouldn't go, and the month came apart.

kept_silence.title: I didn't say how it ends
kept_silence.text: Wren asked if they come back. I said nothing.

long_night.title: The Long Night
long_night.text: The night of day 27, with Wren, a censer and three things to say.

model_rewind.title: Rewind (Hours)
model_rewind.text: Learnt from the hanging shard. Step back to where you stood a moment ago.

model_splash.title: Splash (Luna)
model_splash.text: Studied with Wren in the archive.

model_spark.title: Spark (Mercury)
model_spark.text: Studied with Wren in the archive.

model_undertow.title: Undertow (Luna)
model_undertow.text: Studied with Wren in the archive.

model_arc_lance.title: Arc Lance (Mercury)
model_arc_lance.text: Studied with Wren in the archive.

q_fire.title: Who pulled me from the fire?
options: Someone who carries my brass star

q_door.title: What burned the Observatory door?
options: An Ember Bolt, cast from inside

q_notes.title: Who writes the cipher notes?
options: Someone who has already lived this month

a_fire.title: Someone carries my star
a_fire.text: Whoever pulled me from the fire wears my brass star, nick and all.

a_door.title: My Ember Bolt, from inside
a_door.text: Someone burned their way out of the Observatory with my own spell.

a_notes.title: Someone who has lived this month
a_notes.text: The notes know what happens and when. Whoever writes them has already lived these days.

deaths.north_door: The north door opened, and the dark came in.
deaths.eclipse_alone: The Eclipse came, and nobody sat up with you on the last night.
deaths.long_night: You told Wren how it ends. Wren wouldn't go, and the month came apart.
deaths.eclipse_after_long_night: The Long Night is over. The Eclipse comes, and the month begins again.
deaths.patrol: The Hollows in the street were too many.
